sections.heading: Dashboard widgets show a loading spinner
sections.text: Dashboard widgets load separately after the home page opens. A widget that keeps showing a loading spinner usually has a stale cached response.

steps.text: Ask the user to clear the browser cache for the application site and reload the dashboard.
Ask the user to wait one minute and select Refresh on the affected widget.

information_needed.prompt: Browser name and version from the browser's About page.
The title of the widget that does not load.

stop_conditions.text: If several users at the same site report the same widgets failing, stop and escalate to L2 as a possible service problem.
